newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asiatrust opens five new branches.
newsitem.headline: Asiatrust opens five new branches.

text.p: Philippine development bank Asiatrust Bank said on Wednesday it had opened five new branches as part of its three-year expansion programme.
Asiatrust senior vice president Rodora Banares said in a statement the new branches are located where there are a lot of small and medium enterprises.
The bank is planning to open 15 new branches in the next three years. At present, it has 18 branches.
Asiatrust is one of the country's private development banks. The Asian Development Bank is one of its shareholders.
